required_manual_checks.description: Since 2A.3a-2 applied 010 and the owner's T13 contact, the db phase fails for every tree: 3 tests in 2 PROVEN suites (recorded in 2A.3a-2's unfrozen checkpoint, 'Post-rollout gate state'; that task stays paused until this one is promoted). (1) production-authorization.test.ts:375 expects the error for UPDATE prospects SET status = 'maybe' to name `status`; 010's BEFORE UPDATE trigger prospects_status_has_transition now refuses first with its own message. (2) production-2e-raw-parity.test.ts:138 and :204 hold production's historical 2E rows equal to the frozen vault except for OBSERVED_DRIFT, a hand-maintained list of four reviewed locations; a genuine Sales contact changed contact fields on a historical prospect. Reproduce value-free before changing anything (file, test title and field NAMES only; never slugs' row content, values, emails or URLs).

Correct the expectation, not the property. An invalid enum value must still be REFUSED, and the refusal must come from a named guard: either the prospects status CHECK (SQLSTATE 23514 naming the constraint or column) or the 010 transition trigger (its own raised error and SQLSTATE), and never a permission error, which would mask a missing guard. Add a control that proves the CHECK itself still refuses an invalid status when the trigger does not fire first (for example a catalog assertion that the CHECK constraint exists with the exact allowed set, or an INSERT path the trigger does not cover, inside the existing rolled-back transaction). The website_quality assertion is unchanged. Everything stays inside inRolledBackTx; nothing persists.

Replace 'production never changes after 2E, except four hand-listed locations' with the provenance rule the system already enforces: a historical 2E field may differ from the frozen vault ONLY if the difference is witnessed. Concretely: the Sales-mutable columns that 010 routes through recorded transitions (status, first_contact, last_contact, assigned_to, and any follow-up column 010 defines; enumerate them from 010's own text, not by hand) may differ only when a matching witnessed record exists for that prospect after the 2E import (the 010 transition/contact tables or a prospect event of the corresponding type, read-only). Every other field, and any unwitnessed difference in a Sales-mutable field, still fails. Existing OBSERVED_DRIFT entries are either re-justified under the same rule or kept as a closed, reviewed list that can shrink but never grow; state which. The adversarial control ('an unreviewed mutation cannot be waived') must be kept and extended: a synthetic Sales-field difference WITHOUT a witness fails, and one WITH a synthetic witness passes. The suite stays read-only (BEGIN READ ONLY) and prints no row content.

Neither suite is reclassified away from PROVEN phase db unless the checkpoint shows, with evidence, that the property can no longer be controlled at all; reclassifying to make a gate green is a failing result for this task. No test is skipped, deleted or given a broader waiver than the witness rule. The manifest (gate-2g1.ts) changes only if a row's `why` must describe the new semantics; totality and phase are unchanged.

Audit every PROVEN db-phase suite that reads production for the same obsolete assumption (production data frozen at a past stage, or 009 guard order). List each suite with a one-line verdict in docs/GATE-2G1-005-CHECKPOINT.md. Any further suite that needs a change is a finding requiring a scope change, not an in-task edit.

Value-free: reproduction before; after the change, the full agent-side prove (static, server, db) green for the candidate tree with db pass/fail/pending counts and both suites' counts; mutants showing (a) an unwitnessed Sales-field difference fails raw parity, (b) a permission-denied refusal fails the authorization test, (c) removing the CHECK control's assertion turns a test red. The db phase reads production read-only through the sanctioned inputs; no production write, migration or deployment.

Diff limited to the write paths. No application, schema, script or Coordinator change. After promotion, 2A.3a-2 (claimed, unfrozen) re-proves its checkpoint tree against the corrected model and freezes with its required gates unchanged.

title: GATE-2G1-005 Correct obsolete db-phase proof semantics after migration 010 went live (authorization guard order; 2E raw parity under real Sales writes)
